subject: math
title: Surface Area Using Nets
seo_title: Grade 6 Surface Area and Nets Worksheets: Prisms, Pyramids and Word Problems
standard_text: Represent three-dimensional figures using nets made up of rectangles and triangles, and use the nets to find the surface area of these figures. Apply these techniques in the context of solving real-world and mathematical problems.
meta_desc: Free Grade 6 surface area worksheets: match nets to solids, count faces, and use nets to find the surface area of cubes, rectangular prisms, triangular prisms and square pyramids, plus real-world word problems. 100 practice questions with answers.
key_big: Surface area = the total area of all the faces (the area of the net).
key_sub: Unfold the solid into a net, find the area of each rectangle and triangle, and add them. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces: SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh. The answer is in square units (cm², ft²).
body_html:
What a net is

A net is a flat pattern that folds up into a solid. Each shape in the net is one face of the solid. Surface area is the total area of all the faces, so it is the area of the whole net.

Rectangular prisms and cubes

Find the area of 3 different faces, then double each one, because every face has a matching face.

SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh. A cube has 6 faces that are the same: SA = 6 × s × s.

Box

Find the surface area of the box above: 6 cm long, 3 cm wide, 4 cm tall.

Top and bottom: 2 × (6 × 3) = 36. Front and back: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48. Ends: 2 × (3 × 4) = 24. 36 + 48 + 24 = 108.

Answer: 108 cm²

Pyramids and triangular prisms

A triangle face has area 12 × base × height. Use the height that is at a right angle to the base (the dashed line), not a slanted side.

Box with no top

An open box is 5 in long, 4 in wide and 2 in tall. How much cardboard is it made of?

All 6 faces: 2 × 20 + 2 × 10 + 2 × 8 = 76. No top, so subtract one 5 × 4 face: 76 − 20 = 56.

Answer: 56 in²

Nets of common solids

SolidFaces in the netSurface area
Cube6 equal squares6 × s × s
Rectangular prism6 rectangles in 3 matching pairs2lw + 2lh + 2wh
Triangular prism2 triangles + 3 rectangles2 triangles + (perimeter of triangle) × length
Square pyramid1 square + 4 triangless × s + 4 × 12 × s × (slant height)

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Finding the volume (l × w × h)Add the areas of the faces
Adding only 3 faces of a boxDouble each one: every face has a match
Forgetting the 12 for a triangle12 × base × height
Using the pyramid’s height or a slanted sideUse the height of the triangle face (slant height)
Counting a missing topLeave out faces that are not there (open box, roof, tent with no floor)
Writing cm³Surface area is an area: cm², in², ft²

faq.q: How do you find surface area using a net?
faq.a: Unfold the solid into a net, find the area of each face (rectangles: length × width; triangles: 12 × base × height), and add all the areas. The answer is in square units.

faq.q: What is the formula for the surface area of a rectangular prism?
faq.a: SA = 2lw + 2lh + 2wh. Find the area of the top, front and side, then double each one, because each face has a matching face on the other side.

faq.q: How do you find the surface area of a square pyramid?
faq.a: Add the area of the square base (s × s) and the 4 triangle faces (4 × 12 × s × slant height). Use the slant height, which is the height of a triangle face, not the height of the pyramid.

faq.q: What is the difference between surface area and volume?
faq.a: Surface area is the area that covers the outside of a solid, in square units like cm². Volume is the space inside, in cubic units like cm³.

sets.title: Faces, edges, vertices and matching faces

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face C?
items.e: Face C and face B are both 5 by 3 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face E?
items.e: Faces E and C are in a straight line with one square between them, so they fold onto opposite sides of the cube.

items.q: A rectangular prism is 3 cm by 5 cm by 8 cm. How many of its faces are 3 cm by 5 cm rectangles?
items.e: Faces come in matching pairs: 2 faces are 3 by 5, 2 are 3 by 8 and 2 are 5 by 8.

items.q: This net is folded into a cube. Which face is opposite face F?
items.e: Faces F and E are in a straight line with one square between them, so they fold onto opposite sides of the cube.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face B?

items.q: How many triangles are in a net of a square pyramid?
items.e: A square pyramid has 1 square base and 4 triangle faces, so its net has 4 triangles.

items.q: This is a net of a rectangular prism. Which face is the same size and shape as face E?
items.e: Face E and face D are both 3 by 4 rectangles, so they are opposite faces of the box. A box has 3 pairs of matching faces.

items.q: How many edges does a square pyramid have?
items.e: A square pyramid has 5 faces, 8 edges and 5 vertices. Faces are the flat sides, edges are where 2 faces meet, and vertices are the corners.

sets.title: Surface area of cubes and rectangular prisms

items.q: This is a net of a cube. What is the surface area of the cube?
items.e: Each face is a square: 3 × 3 = 9 cm². There are 6 faces: 6 × 9 = 54 cm².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48. Front and back: 2 × (6 × 8) = 96. Two sides: 2 × (4 × 8) = 64. Add: 48 + 96 + 64 = 208 in². Do not stop at 3 faces: each face has a matching face.

items.q: This is a net of a cube. What is the surface area of the cube?
items.e: Each face is a square: 7 × 7 = 49 ft². There are 6 faces: 6 × 49 = 294 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
A cube has a surface area of 96 cm². What is the area of one face?
items.e: A cube has 6 faces that are the same: 96 ÷ 6 = 16 cm². (Each edge is 4 cm, since 4 × 4 = 16.)

items.q: A cube has edges that are 8 ft long. What is its surface area?
items.e: One face: 8 × 8 = 64 ft². Six faces: 6 × 64 = 384 ft². 512 is the volume, and 256 counts only 4 faces.

items.q: This is a net of a cube. What is the surface area of the cube?
items.e: Each face is a square: 9 × 9 = 81 m². There are 6 faces: 6 × 81 = 486 m².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (5 × 4) = 40. Front and back: 2 × (5 × 3) = 30. Two sides: 2 × (4 × 3) = 24. Add: 40 + 30 + 24 = 94 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of this rectangular prism?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (6 × 5) = 60. Front and back: 2 × (6 × 2) = 24. Two sides: 2 × (5 × 2) = 20. Add: 60 + 24 + 20 = 104 m². Surface area covers the outside, so it is in square units, not cubic units.

items.q: A box is 9 in long, 4 in wide and 3 in tall. Which expression gives its surface area?
items.e: The faces are 9 × 4 = 36, 9 × 3 = 27 and 4 × 3 = 12, and each face has a match: 2 × 36 + 2 × 27 + 2 × 12 = 150 in². 9 × 4 × 3 is the volume.

items.q: This is a net of a cube. What is the surface area of the cube?
items.e: Each face is a square: 5 × 5 = 25 in². There are 6 faces: 6 × 25 = 150 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (12 × 6) = 144. Front and back: 2 × (12 × 5) = 120. Two sides: 2 × (6 × 5) = 60. Add: 144 + 120 + 60 = 324 cm².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (11 × 7) = 154. Front and back: 2 × (11 × 5) = 110. Two sides: 2 × (7 × 5) = 70. Add: 154 + 110 + 70 = 334 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (7 × 4) = 56. Front and back: 2 × (7 × 2) = 28. Two sides: 2 × (4 × 2) = 16. Add: 56 + 28 + 16 = 100 m². Do not stop at 3 faces: each face has a matching face.

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (11 × 6) = 132. Front and back: 2 × (11 × 4) = 88. Two sides: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48. Add: 132 + 88 + 48 = 268 cm².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (11 × 6) = 132. Front and back: 2 × (11 × 8) = 176. Two sides: 2 × (6 × 8) = 96. Add: 132 + 176 + 96 = 404 cm². Do not stop at 3 faces: each face has a matching face.

items.q: What is the surface area of this rectangular prism?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (10 × 5) = 100. Front and back: 2 × (10 × 9) = 180. Two sides: 2 × (5 × 9) = 90. Add: 100 + 180 + 90 = 370 ft². Surface area covers the outside, so it is in square units, not cubic units.

items.q: What is the surface area of this rectangular prism?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (6 × 4) = 48. Front and back: 2 × (6 × 3) = 36. Two sides: 2 × (4 × 3) = 24. Add: 48 + 36 + 24 = 108 in². Surface area covers the outside, so it is in square units, not cubic units.

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (5 × 2) = 20. Front and back: 2 × (5 × 3) = 30. Two sides: 2 × (2 × 3) = 12. Add: 20 + 30 + 12 = 62 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the rectangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (11 × 7) = 154. Front and back: 2 × (11 × 8) = 176. Two sides: 2 × (7 × 8) = 112. Add: 154 + 176 + 112 = 442 ft². Do not stop at 3 faces: each face has a matching face.

sets.title: Surface area of pyramids and triangular prisms

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 7 × 7 = 49. One triangle: 12 × 7 × 10 = 35. Four triangles: 4 × 35 = 140. Total: 49 + 140 = 189 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 4 × 4 = 16. One triangle: 12 × 4 × 6 = 12. Four triangles: 4 × 12 = 48. Total: 16 + 48 = 64 cm². Remember the 12 in the triangle area.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 8 × 8 = 64. One triangle: 12 × 8 × 7 = 28. Four triangles: 4 × 28 = 112. Total: 64 + 112 = 176 m².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 6 × 8 = 48. Three rectangles: (6 + 8 + 10) × 12 = 24 × 12 = 288. Total: 48 + 288 = 336 ft².

items.q: A square pyramid has a base 10 in on each side. The pyramid is 12 in tall, and the slant height (the height of each triangle face) is 13 in. What is its surface area?
items.e: Base: 10 × 10 = 100. One triangle: 12 × 10 × 13 = 65. Four triangles: 4 × 65 = 260. Total: 100 + 260 = 360 in². Use the slant height 13, not the height of the pyramid, for the triangle faces.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 7 = 12 × 7 = 84. Total: 12 + 84 = 96 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 5 × 12 = 60. Three rectangles: (5 + 12 + 13) × 10 = 30 × 10 = 300. Total: 60 + 300 = 360 m².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 6 × 4 = 24. Three rectangles: (5 + 6 + 5) × 9 = 16 × 9 = 144. Total: 24 + 144 = 168 ft². Use the dashed height (4 ft), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 10 × 12 = 120. Three rectangles: (13 + 10 + 13) × 15 = 36 × 15 = 540. Total: 120 + 540 = 660 cm². Use the dashed height (12 cm), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: Which expression gives the surface area of this square pyramid?
items.e: The base is 7 × 7. Each of the 4 triangles is 12 × 7 × 9. Total: 49 + 126 = 175 m².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 16 × 6 = 96. Three rectangles: (10 + 16 + 10) × 20 = 36 × 20 = 720. Total: 96 + 720 = 816 in². Use the dashed height (6 in), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 9 = 12 × 9 = 108. Total: 12 + 108 = 120 in².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 8 × 3 = 24. Three rectangles: (5 + 8 + 5) × 10 = 18 × 10 = 180. Total: 24 + 180 = 204 m². Use the dashed height (3 m), not the slanted side, for the triangles.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 5 = 15. Four triangles: 4 × 15 = 60. Total: 36 + 60 = 96 in².

items.q: A triangular prism has right-triangle bases with sides 3 ft, 4 ft and 5 ft. The prism is 6 ft long. Which expression gives its surface area?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 3 × 4 = 12. Three rectangles: (3 + 4 + 5) × 6 = 72. Total: 12 + 72 = 84 ft².

items.q: What is the surface area of the triangular prism made from this net?
items.e: Two triangles: 2 × 12 × 9 × 12 = 108. Three rectangles: (9 + 12 + 15) × 20 = 36 × 20 = 720. Total: 108 + 720 = 828 cm².

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 10 × 10 = 100. One triangle: 12 × 10 × 12 = 60. Four triangles: 4 × 60 = 240. Total: 100 + 240 = 340 cm². Remember the 12 in the triangle area.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 5 × 5 = 25. One triangle: 12 × 5 × 8 = 20. Four triangles: 4 × 20 = 80. Total: 25 + 80 = 105 ft².

items.q: A square pyramid has a base 6 cm on each side. The pyramid is 4 cm tall, and the slant height (the height of each triangle face) is 5 cm. What is its surface area?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 5 = 15. Four triangles: 4 × 15 = 60. Total: 36 + 60 = 96 cm². Use the slant height 5, not the height of the pyramid, for the triangle faces.

items.q: What is the surface area of the square pyramid made from this net?
items.e: Base: 6 × 6 = 36. One triangle: 12 × 6 × 9 = 27. Four triangles: 4 × 27 = 108. Total: 36 + 108 = 144 in².

items.q: Owen paints the outside of a toy box with no lid. The box is 4 ft long, 2 ft wide and 2 ft tall. How many square feet does he paint?
items.e: All 6 faces: 2 × 8 + 2 × 8 + 2 × 4 = 40 ft². There is no top, so subtract one 4 × 2 face: 40 − 8 = 32 ft².

items.q: Ava covers only the 4 sides of a box (not the top or bottom). The box is 10 cm long, 6 cm wide and 8 cm tall. How much paper does she use?
items.e: Front and back: 2 × (10 × 8) = 160. Two sides: 2 × (6 × 8) = 96. Total: 160 + 96 = 256 cm².

items.q: Box A is a cube with 6 in edges. Box B is 9 in by 4 in by 6 in. Both hold 216 in³. Which box needs more paper to cover it?
items.e: A: 6 × 36 = 216 in². B: 2 × 36 + 2 × 54 + 2 × 24 = 228 in². B needs 228 − 216 = 12 in² more. The same volume does not mean the same surface area.

items.q: A cube has a surface area of 150 cm². How long is each edge?
items.e: 6 faces share 150 cm², so one face is 150 ÷ 6 = 25 cm². A square with area 25 has 5 cm sides (5 × 5 = 25).

items.q: A room is 12 ft long, 10 ft wide and 8 ft tall. How many square feet are painted if the 4 walls and the ceiling are painted, but not the floor?
A paperweight is a square pyramid. Its base is 4 cm on each side, and each triangle face has a height of 5 cm. What is its total surface area?
items.e: Base: 4 × 4 = 16. Triangles: 4 × 12 × 4 × 5 = 40. Total: 16 + 40 = 56 cm².

items.q: Jack covers a cube-shaped gift box with paper. Each edge is 10 cm. How much paper does he need?
items.e: One face: 10 × 10 = 100 cm². Six faces: 6 × 100 = 600 cm². 1,000 is the volume in cm³.

items.q: Sam paints every face of a wooden cube with 3 in edges. How much area does he paint?
items.e: One face: 3 × 3 = 9 in². Six faces: 6 × 9 = 54 in². 27 is the volume, and 36 counts only 4 faces.

items.q: A wooden sandbox has a bottom but no top. It is 6 ft long, 4 ft wide and 1 ft tall. How many square feet of wood is it made of?
items.e: Bottom: 6 × 4 = 24. Long sides: 2 × (6 × 1) = 12. Short sides: 2 × (4 × 1) = 8. No top: 24 + 12 + 8 = 44 ft².

items.q: A tent is a triangular prism. Each end is a triangle with a base of 6 ft and a height of 4 ft, and the slanted sides are 5 ft wide. The tent is 8 ft long. How much fabric covers the 2 ends, the 2 slanted sides and the floor?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 6 × 4 = 24. Slanted sides: 2 × 5 × 8 = 80. Floor: 6 × 8 = 48. Total: 24 + 80 + 48 = 152 ft².

items.q: Lily paints all 6 faces of a wooden chest that is 5 ft long, 3 ft wide and 2 ft tall. Paint costs $2 for each square foot. How much does the paint cost?
A fish tank with no lid is 20 in long, 10 in wide and 12 in tall. How much glass is used to make it?
items.e: Bottom: 20 × 10 = 200. Front and back: 2 × (20 × 12) = 480. Ends: 2 × (10 × 12) = 240. No lid, so the total is 200 + 480 + 240 = 920 in².

items.q: A tent has no floor. Its ends are triangles with a base of 8 ft and a height of 3 ft. The two slanted sides are 5 ft by 10 ft. How much fabric is in the tent?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 8 × 3 = 24. Sides: 2 × 5 × 10 = 100. No floor, so the total is 24 + 100 = 124 ft².

items.q: A cereal box is 8 in wide, 3 in deep and 12 in tall. How much cardboard is used to make it (no overlaps)?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (8 × 3) = 48. Front and back: 2 × (8 × 12) = 192. Two sides: 2 × (3 × 12) = 72. Add: 48 + 192 + 72 = 312 in².

items.q: A roof is shaped like a square pyramid with no bottom. The base is 12 ft on each side, and each triangle has a slant height of 10 ft. How many square feet of shingles cover the 4 triangles?
items.e: One triangle: 12 × 12 × 10 = 60 ft². Four triangles: 4 × 60 = 240 ft². The base is not part of the roof.

items.q: Noah wraps 2 boxes that are the same. Each box is 6 cm by 4 cm by 3 cm. How much paper does he need for both boxes?
Which unit could be used for the surface area of a box?
items.e: Surface area is the area of all the faces, so it is in square units, like in². Cubic inches measure volume.

items.q: A planter is a cube with an open top. Each edge is 2 ft. How much area of the outside is painted (no top)?
items.e: One face: 2 × 2 = 4 ft². The planter has 5 faces (no top): 5 × 4 = 20 ft².

items.q: A wooden ramp is a triangular prism. Its ends are right triangles with sides 5 ft, 12 ft and 13 ft, and the ramp is 3 ft wide. How much area is painted if every face is painted?
items.e: Ends: 2 × 12 × 5 × 12 = 60. Rectangles: (5 + 12 + 13) × 3 = 90. Total: 60 + 90 = 150 ft².

items.q: Eli wraps a gift box that is 12 in long, 8 in wide and 4 in tall. How much wrapping paper covers the box with no overlap?
items.e: Top and bottom: 2 × (12 × 8) = 192. Front and back: 2 × (12 × 4) = 96. Two sides: 2 × (8 × 4) = 64. Add: 192 + 96 + 64 = 352 in².
